Definition: shape (as if cut out); base (as if there cut off)
BiblicalUsage: The two cherubim in the temple are of one measure and one size, and Jonah goes down to the bottoms — the very bases — of the mountains. The word is the shape cut out, the base where a thing is cut off.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God measures the cherubim and the mountain roots alike, and nothing in his world is without its shape.
